original.description: Cropped portrait of Josias von Heeringen, Prussian Minister of War, by Nicola Perscheid.
original.archive: Wikimedia Commons; the record cites a Getty Images editorial scan of the original print
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"). Perscheid died in 1930, so the work is out of copyright on life + 70.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: leave as it is until a larger scan is found — 443 px will not stand colour work.

caption: Josias von Heeringen, Prussian Minister of War until 1913 and commander of the German Seventh Army in Lorraine in 1914.
credit: Original photograph: Nicola Perscheid, 1914; via Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Same provenance pattern as the Bülow portrait already in the registry — a Getty editorial scan of a print whose photographer died in 1930. Low resolution.
